title: Literature Search with Zotero
tagline: Systematic search strategies, open scholarly databases, and automated reference management.
outcomes: Formulate complex Boolean search queries with wildcards, truncations, and parentheses.
Search open scholarly databases including OpenAlex, Crossref, and PubMed alongside Google Scholar.
Evaluate journal quality and indexing status using the HEC Journal Recognition System (HJRS).
Manage a comprehensive research library and automate citations in Word using Zotero.

modules.title: Module 1: Search Architecture & Boolean Logic
modules.description: Construct high-precision keyword queries and systematic search strings.

lessons.title: Developing Search Strings from Research Questions
Boolean Operators (AND, OR, NOT), Wildcards & Nesting

modules.title: Module 2: Scholarly Databases & Source Evaluation
modules.description: Navigate open bibliographic data, snowballing methods, and predatory journal flags.

lessons.title: Google Scholar vs OpenAlex, Crossref & PubMed
Identifying & Avoiding Predatory Journals (HEC HJRS Guide)

modules.title: Module 3: Zotero Setup & Library Management
modules.description: Configure Zotero, collect web metadata, and organize files with tags and collections.

lessons.title: Installing Zotero, Browser Connector & PDF Indexing
Organizing Collections, Tags, and PDF Annotations

modules.title: Module 4: Writing with Zotero in Microsoft Word
modules.description: Insert dynamic citations, switch citation styles, and log search strategies for PRISMA.

lessons.title: The Zotero Word Plugin: Inserting & Editing Citations
Managing Search Logs for PRISMA Systematic Reviews
Literature Search with Zotero Final Check
